# SOX Live Install E2E Test Project

This is a minimal Claude Code project fixture used by the SOX Protocol live install end-to-end test suite.

## Purpose

This project skeleton exists to:
1. Have SOX Protocol installed into it by the test driver (phase 03)
2. Serve as the working directory for `claude --print` subprocess invocations
3. Prove that the full install→messaging path works with real Claude agents

## What gets added at test time

The phase 03 test driver runs the SOX installer against a copy of this directory:

```
sox-protocol install --project-dir <tmp_copy>
# (legacy long form: python -m sox_protocol.adapters.runtimes.claude_code install)
```

That install step writes:
- `.claude/skills/inter-agent-channels/SKILL.md` — the rendered discipline skill
- `.mcp.json` — MCP server entry pointing at the test venv's sox_protocol
- `.claude/settings.json` — hooks + allowedMcpServers
- Inserts the bootstrap line into `.claude/agents/alice.md` and `.claude/agents/bob.md`

## Agent roles

- `alice` — creates the group, invites bob, sends PING
- `bob` — joins the group, reads PING, sends PONG

## Do not edit this file in isolation

This fixture is part of the `live-install-e2e` engagement. Changes to agent prompts must
keep tool names aligned with the registered MCP surface in
`packages/python/src/sox_protocol/core/mcp_server/tools.py`.
